36747296.trial: low-dose colchicine after non-CABG cardiac surgery (Crit Care 2023)

25784519.verified: randomised colchicine vs placebo from 48 h before to 8 days after CABG; primary outcome hsTnT; AF not in abstract

32175647.trial: colchicine and echocardiographic constrictive physiology after CABG (Echocardiography 2020)
32175647.verified: parallel randomised double-blind colchicine vs placebo after open-heart surgery; AF not in abstract

12574898.trial: colchicine for prevention of postpericardiotomy syndrome (Herz 2002)
12574898.verified: colchicine for primary prevention of PPS after cardiac surgery; AF not in abstract
